The Seller should submit the following declaration:- 2.1 Declaration Regarding Blacklisting/debarment from any Government Origination. 2.2 Declaration Regarding Bank Default. 2.3 Declaration Regarding compliance of BOQ.

3. Scope of Supply: The seller shall supply all items strictly in accordance with the technical specifications, quantity, quality and requirements mentioned in the GeM bid. 4. Quality of Materials: All items shall be brand new, unused and free from manufacturing defects, damage or inferior-quality materials. Refurbished, repaired or second-hand items shall not be accepted. 5. Design and Customization: The design, dimensions, inscription, colour scheme, lettering and other custo mization requirements for the Unit Citation, Unit Tenure Sash and Gallant Warrior Stand shall confirm to th e specifications and artwork approved by the Buyer. 6. Design Proof Approval: The vendor should attend the Pre Bid meeting for finalisation of design, lettering and colour of the items before opening of Technical Bid. 7. Sample and Inspection: The Buyer may inspect the items or require a sample where specified in the bid. Any sample submission requirement shall be clearly stated, proportionate to the procurement and consist ent with applicable GeM provisions. 8. No Unauthorized Substitution: The seller shall not substitute the specified material, model, design, dime nsions or quality with an inferior alternative without prior written approval from the Buyer, wherever such approval is permissible under the contract. 9. The participating seller shall submit a physical sample or printed design on paper on the relevant item t o the buyer for inspection and approval before closing date and time of the Bid. Non submission of the sam e will leads to rejection of the participant. 10. The seller shall be responsible for all costs associated with preparing and submitting the sample/ Desig n. 11. Workmanship and Finishing: All customized items shall have neat finishing, properly aligned lettering, uniform embroidery, secure stitching and a professional appearance. The fan and measuring tape shall be free from visible defects and functional irregularities. 12. Compliance with Technical Specifications: All supplied items shall conform to the technical specificatio ns mentioned in the bid and applicable Indian standards, wherever relevant. The seller shall ensure that th e offered products meet all mandatory safety and quality requirements. Documents regarding the same sh ould be submitted. 13. Delivery Period: The seller shall deliver the complete supply to the delivery location specified in the Ge M contract within the stipulated delivery period. Any extension shall be governed by the applicable contra ctual provisions. 14. Packing and Transportation: The seller shall ensure proper packing and safe transportation of all items to prevent damage, moisture exposure, scratches, deformation or other deterioration during transit. The a pplicable costs shall be included in the quoted price as per the bid conditions. 15. Inspection and Acceptance: All items shall be subject to inspection by the Buyer or an authorized repre sentative for conformity with the specifications, quantity, quality, design and workmanship. Final acceptan ce shall be subject to satisfactory inspection in accordance with the contract. 16. Rejection of Defective Items: Items found damaged, defective, incomplete or materially non-conformin g to the contractual specifications may be rejected in accordance with the GeM contract. Incorrect inscripti ons, poor embroidery, inferior fabric, damaged components or non-functional equipment shall not be acce pted. 17. Replacement and Rectification: The seller shall rectify or replace defective or rejected items attributabl e to the seller within the period specified by the Buyer, subject to applicable contractual provisions. No add itional payment shall be admissible for such rectification or replacement where the defect is the seller's re sponsibility. 18. Price and Warranty: The quoted price shall include all costs associated with the specified materials, cu stomization, embroidery, finishing, packing and delivery, as applicable. The portable stand fan shall carry t he warranty specified in the bid and offered under the applicable contract. Warranty and defect-liability obl igations for other items shall be governed by the bid conditions and contract. 19. Compliance with GeM Terms and Contractual Obligations: The seller shall comply with the GeM General Terms and Conditions, bid-specific conditions and applicable procurement rules. Any failure to perform con tractual obligations, supply conforming goods or meet the delivery requirements shall be dealt with under

the applicable GeM provisions. No condition of this ATC shall override mandatory GeM rules. 20. The Buyer reserve the rights to reject any submitted design or sample that does not confirm to the pre scribed specification, quality requirement and design criteria mentioned in the bid during technical evaluation. .
